narration.reasoning: The relayer calls execTransaction on the Safe (c0, c1), which verifies two owner signatures via ecrecover (c2, c3) and increments the Safe's nonce from 1 to 2 (s2). The Safe then calls addOwnerWithThreshold(0x2C81904f370e7f6490aEa328CA847AEFdc3853D3, 1) on itself (c4, c5). This adds Ravi (0x2C81904f370e7f6490aEa328CA847AEFdc3853D3) to the Safe's owner linked list (s3, s4), increments the owner count from 3 to 4 (s0), and emits AddedOwner (e1). It also lowers the Safe's confirmation threshold from 2 to 1 (s1) and emits ChangedThreshold (e2), followed by ExecutionSuccess (e0). No ETH or token balances change.

effects.sentence: Ravi (0x2C81904f370e7f6490aEa328CA847AEFdc3853D3) is added as an owner of the Safe, increasing the owner count from 3 to 4.
The Safe's signature threshold is lowered from 2 to 1.
The Safe verifies signatures, increments its nonce from 1 to 2, and records successful execution.
